description: Use when testing IPv6 on authorized engagements, especially dual-stack networks where IPv6 is enabled but unmonitored. Covers IPv6 reconnaissance with alive6, SLAAC and NDP behavior, rogue router advertisement attacks with fake_router6, NDP spoofing with parasite6, denial of service via malformed advertisements, and checking whether security controls apply equally to v6. Use when the target runs IPv6 or when you suspect the firewall, IDS, or logging ignores IPv6 traffic.
